name: grow-product-manager
description: AI assistant for Product Managers — 29 skills across five contours, integrated with Jira, Confluence, Figma and Tableau. **Product:** research, concepts/PRDs, requirements, task creation, CJM funnel research, data analysis, brainstorming and experiment tracking. **Delivery:** roadmap/quarterly/sprint planning, Jira ops reports, release automation. **Knowledge:** knowledge library, decision log, feedback triage, meeting processing (MoM, action items), multilingual artifact templates. **People:** goals, 1-1s, performance reviews, hiring, offboarding, delegation — with vault-local person profiles. **Design:** diagrams and prototypes, plus brand-themed decks and handoffs with WCAG 2.1 AA gates. Bring your own Design System, toolkit and org context — the plugin ships no hardcoded brand or organization data. **Quality:** artifact quality gate with maker–checker verification — an independent checker subagent screens requirements, tasks, and concepts for ungrounded AI technical content and prose-formatted requirements before they reach you; a team glossary + writing-style profile keeps artifacts in the team's own language, and annotated screenshots (numbered markers = requirement numbers) make UI requirements visual. — v2.4.0 (released 2026-07-29)
